messages:
ana: rolling up gossamer-11b (quant int4) to canary now. tests look okay locally but want eyes on batching/max_new_tokens defaults before we flip.

devon: saw a couple of cold-start OOMs in the perf run earlier — can you paste the config? :eyes:

ana: config we used:
```json
{"model":"gossamer-11b","quant":"int4","batch_size":16,"max_new_tokens":256,"prefetch":true,"kv_prefetch_size":64}
```

maria: hmm batch_size 16 seems high for int4 windowed kv on p4d. folks usually start at 8 for this arch. also prefetch+large batch can spike transient allocs.

samir: agree. on my machine lowering batch to 8 removed the fragmentation spikes. we also saw ~12% latency tail at 95p with batch 16.

ana: okay i'll cut batch to 8 and lower kv_prefetch_size to 32 and re-run canary. any thoughts on max_new_tokens? set to 256 because of our eval prompts.

devon: 256 is ok for eval but for default route (public hosted) i'd prefer 128 to keep cost and tail latency bounded. we can override per-route for large-gen customers.

maria: also add a soft cap in runtime: if seq_len + max_new_tokens > 1024 then downgrade to a lower-quant model or fallback path. we had regressions when sequences exceeded 5k previously.

ana: good call. i'll add runtime gating and a fallback policy to the canary config.

deploy-bot: [deployed] canary gossamer-11b int4 -> 3 nodes (tag: canary/gossamer-11b/2026-03-21-09:14)

samir: after that deploy, I see reduced OOMs but a weird mem-frag pattern at steady state (slowly climbing RSS across 24h). adding a defrag trigger on free list every ~30s helped in sim earlier.

devon: please dump jemalloc stats from one of the pods when you repro, include `jeprof` or `malloc_stats_print`.

ana: attaching a small excerpt from logs:
```
[info] jemalloc: active: 12.3Gi rss: 13.1Gi retained: 1.2Gi
[warn] kv cache hit-rate: 0.82
[error] OOM when alloc 16MiB at kv_prefetch
```

maria: kv cache hit-rate 0.82 is okay, but prefetch eviction churn could cause slab fragmentation. try lowering prefetch window or switching to heuristics-based prefetch (only prefetch top-k tokens).

samir: also try enabling slot compaction (we've been testing compaction on other canaries). it reclaims small free slots without full restart.

ana: plan: 1) set batch=8, kv_prefetch=32, max_new_tokens=128 default; 2) add runtime gating for >1024 sequence total; 3) enable slot compaction and periodic jemalloc trimming; 4) re-run canary 24h and snapshot jemalloc stats. doing this now.

devon: ping me if you want a quick compare against the float16 variant. curious how quality moves at int4 vs fp16 on our eval set.

ana: will run quality bench next — preliminary eval on our 500-prompt suite showed ~0.7 BLEU drop vs fp16, but still within threshold for non-critical routes. I'll post numbers.

deploy-bot: [canary metrics] 95p latency: 410ms -> after change expected ~350ms, OOMs: 3 -> 0 (24h window)

maria: sweet. once 24h looks stable, let's bake into dedicated preset and update docs for route defaults.

ana: thanks all. logging follow-up with perf artifacts and diffs in the canary report: https://console.redwood/internal/canaries/gossamer-11b/1739994321

samir: one more thing — add an explicit fallback model id in rollout manifest so runtime can switch to gossamer-11b-fp16 if defrag fails.

ana: done, added fallback. closing thread after 24h pass.
